title: Economic complexity
source: The Growth Lab at Harvard University, Growth Projections and Complexity Rankings, Harvard Dataverse; World Bank, Economic Fitness 2; WIPO (2025), Global Innovation Index 2025
note: The Economic Complexity Index scores each country on how many different goods it exports and how few other countries can make them. It counts goods exports only, not services such as tourism, education or software. Ranks use the HS92 product classification. The World Bank's Economic Fitness is another goods-based measure; WIPO's Global Innovation Index takes a wider view of research, skills, business and creative output.
